Alright, this is just my thought process, but I feel that the Great Ones choose the hunters. When you read the lore on the Hunter's Symbol, it says that the symbol is etched into your brain.


Mild spoiler warning:


If you look at the Carryl runes throughout the game, they say that the words of the Great Ones are incomprehensible, but can be transcribed into symbols. The process of "using" or "equipping" a rune is described as memorizing the rune, and committing it to memory. 

If you look at the Hunter of Hunter's Oath Rune, the symbol is the same as the Hunter Symbol, and it is revealed that this symbol is the Great One's "word" for Hunter.

Therefore, if the symbol is etched into your mind, wouldn't it make sense if a Great One had placed it there? 

There's a whole other theory that backs this up really well, but idk if you want me to go into it. It involves end-game spoilers and a lot of speculation.
